notes: Zero cause/effect (eitza or cause-type) edges were found in torahData.js for reference === 117. Torah #117 contains only 3 edges in the dataset, all of type 'bechina'. The additions file (torah_117_additions.json) also confirms total_reference_117_eitza_edges: 0. Although the source text does contain causal reasoning (e.g., the serpent brought death, sleep is 1/60 of death; Elijah's revelation repels the serpent and therefore repels sleep; daat is present on Motzaei Shabbat therefore sleep departs), none of these causal relationships have been captured as eitza/cause edges in the dataset. No enrichment of bechina packages with cause/effect nodes is possible until such edges are added to torahData.js.
